name: Shiguresato Himeno
source:
Affiliation: Hazuki Private School 1st year, Group A (Formerly: Minazuki Government School)
Favorite food: Cinnamon cookies
Gift: Iron Maiden (The ability to be invulnerable to physical and mental damage by hardening the body and the mental strength)

Himeno is the Student Council President of Minazuki Government School, which means she's one of the candidates who'll compete with [url=/c10096]Suina[/url] and [url=/c10097]Sakura[/url] for World Presidency. However, she has a different motive of obtaining Noah: they wanted to destroy Noah. Her gift, Iron Maiden has a weakness. She can not swim, because she will sink. She is also weak to poison gas because the gas will damage her internally.

[From [url=http://visualnovelspam.blogspot.fi/2013/08/hyperhighspeedgenius-thoughts.html]Visual Novel Spam[/url]]
